expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.comp==='vastus' && S.U===1.5 && S.L===1 && S.A===0.2 && S.marks===0 && S.speed===1 ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===3 && R[0].min==='0' && R[0].max==='3' && R[0].step==='0.1' && R[1].min==='0.5' && R[1].max==='2' && R[1].step==='0.25' && R[2].min==='0.1' && R[2].max==='0.4' && R[2].step==='0.05' ? 1 : 0 })()

note: component select (vastus, hehkulamppu, konstantaanilanka) and the speed select hidas/normaali/nopea

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b.length===2 && b[0]==='Merkitse piste' && b[1]==='Tyhjennä kuvaaja' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Merkitse piste first, then Tyhjennä kuvaaja; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='A,L,U,comp' && P.U.unit==='V' && P.L.unit==='m' && P.A.unit==='mm²' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares comp, U (V), L (m) and A (mm²)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?960:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x960 (stacked panels) when #sim-root is under 500 px

expr: (() => { const t=document.querySelector('#sim-root .readout').textContent; return t.indexOf('Jännitemittari')>=0 && t.indexOf('Virtamittari')>=0 && t.indexOf('Ω')<0 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: the readout shows the meters' U and I, not the resistance (the student computes U : I)
